title: CSM deep research suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority research preferences for the csm-deep-research namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only default triage tier and default source mode are configurable, and both remain per-run overridable by triage; citation discipline, role separation, browse verb allowlist, lifecycle, credentials, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

defaultTier.description: Default research tier used when a run does not triage to one explicitly.

defaultSourceMode.description: Default source mode used when a run does not declare one; local-only runs never browse.
